card.name: "Used with" equipment compatibility statements
card.fires_on: The word "used" (or "be"/"recommended" just before it) after "can be", "may be" or "should be" when saying a drug may be used with a device, such as an insulin pump, infusion tubing or contrast system.

modes.label: Insulin pump compatibility
modes.description: Directions to check a pump manual to see if a named insulin can be used with the pump.
modes.example: Refer to the continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion pump user manual to see if HUMALOG can be<< used>> with the insulin pump.

modes.label: Tubing or contrast system use
modes.description: Statements that an injection may or should be used with certain tubing or a contrast media system.

modes.label: Not recommended for use
modes.description: Negated or advisory wording just before "for use with" a device or agent.
modes.example: KOH containing CO 2 absorbents are not<< recommended>> for use with sevoflur

card.writes: It pushes the model to produce "use"/"used" forms, as in "used with".
card.plain: It fires on "can be used" when the label says which device or tubing a drug may be used with.
